headlines: Revenue of $13,852,035 — up 6.1% YoY (vs $13,061,701 in Jun 2025); segment peak $13,852,035 in Jun 2026.
EBITDA of $2,517,745 — up 10.5% YoY (vs $2,279,352 in Jun 2025); trailing trend flat (segment trough $1,812,865 in Sep 2024).
Income Before Taxes has been growing for 21 months (99.2% cumulative) — a sustained drift, not a one-month spike.
Liabilities and Equity has moved up 6 months in a row ($6,059,520 cumulative) to $56,902,783.
Beginning Debt has moved down 21 months in a row (($4,321,949) cumulative) to $100,654,772.
Sequentially (May 2026 to Jun 2026), revenue rose $35,217 yet net income fell to $1,032,520 — driven mainly by Maintenance Programs ($287,254).

methodology: Company-prepared/unaudited monthly financials model (read via monitor_lib). EBITDA is the model's single pinned bridge row. Normalized metrics strip config.comparability_items. Ratios are spot on latest-month flows; leverage/coverage are TTM within the current same-basis segment when >=12 such months exist. Standouts, drift, trend and the MoM bridge are objective/mechanical and confined to same-basis segments; the line read covers EVERY IS/BS leaf with rule-based flags (no statistical gating); narrative interpretation is left to synthesis.
